title: Service target form
purpose: Create a service target or change what it covers, its first-response and resolution times, its calendar and whether it is active. Editing needs a reason.
summary: Set the first-response and resolution times for a category or group and a priority. Editing needs a reason. Only the admin role can open this form.

tasks.title: Add a target
steps: Enter the [[Target name]], then choose the [[Category or group]] and [[Priority]] it covers, or leave them on any.
Enter a [[First-response time]], a [[Resolution time]], or both, with their units.
Choose a [[Calendar]] to count only opening hours, then select [[Create target]].

tasks.title: Change a target
steps: Change the details and write the [[Reason for change]].
Select [[Save changes]]. Tickets created or recalculated afterwards use the new values.

tasks.title: Pause the clock for third parties
steps: Tick [[Pause while waiting on a third party]] and save. Waiting on the client always pauses it.

tasks.title: Retire a target
steps: Clear [[Active]], give the reason and save. Tickets keep the times they were given.

good_to_know: Only one active target can cover a category and priority. Change the existing one, or deactivate it first.
Give at least one time. A target with only a first-response time, or only a resolution time, is fine.
Changing a target never moves tickets that already have their times. Retiring one means new and recalculated tickets use the next most specific target.
If someone else changed the target after you opened the form, saving is refused and your input stays.

items.label: Target name
items.description: Required, up to 120 characters. What staff see, such as Urgent tickets.

items.label: Category or group
items.description: Any category, or one active category (shown as Group: Category), or a whole group (shown with (whole group)). A group covers every category in it. A more specific choice beats a broader one.

items.label: Priority
items.description: Any priority, or Low, Normal, High or Urgent.

items.label: First-response time
items.description: Optional whole number greater than zero. How long a ticket may wait for a first reply.

items.label: Resolution time
items.description: Optional whole number greater than zero. How long a ticket may stay unresolved, not counting paused time.

items.label: Unit
items.description: Minutes or hours, one for each time; hours by default. When editing, a time that is a whole number of hours is shown in hours, otherwise in minutes.

items.label: Calendar
items.description: An active business calendar, or Around the clock. Times count only the calendar's opening hours, less its holidays.

items.label: Pause while waiting on a third party
items.description: Off by default. When on, the resolution clock also pauses while the ticket is Waiting on third party. It always pauses while Waiting on client.

items.label: Active
items.description: Edit only. An inactive target is not used for new tickets. Tickets keep the times they were given; new and recalculated tickets use the next most specific target.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Edit only, required. Kept with the change in the history.

items.label: One active target per scope
items.description: A second active target for the same category and priority is refused with a message to change that one or deactivate it first. Any category and any priority count as values of their own.

items.label: At least one time
items.description: A form with neither time is refused. A time of zero, a negative number or text is refused beside the field.

items.label: Inactive choices
items.description: A new target cannot use an inactive category, group or calendar. When editing, the one already chosen stays selectable even if it is now inactive.

items.label: When it takes effect
items.description: A new target is used by tickets created after it, and by tickets whose category or priority changes after it. The success message says so.

items.label: Create target / Save changes
items.description: Saves and returns to Service targets. Each creation and change is audited with the person and time and, for changes, the reason and the values before and after. A save with no change is refused with Change at least one detail before saving.

items.label: Changed by someone else
items.description: If the target changed after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload and review it.

items.label: Inactive notice
items.description: While the stored target is inactive the form says it is not used for new tickets.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to Service targets without saving.
